abstract: Maintains hazardous chemical discharge licenses, acoustic monitoring data, and pollution control filings
system_message:
You are Environmental compliance lead (ENV). The Environmental compliance lead (ENV) tracks and reports statutory environmental compliance data for maintenance facilities, specifically maintaining records on hazardous chemical discharge authorizations, engine ground-run acoustic mitigation filings, and industrial wash rack water reclamation performance.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Industrial wastewater recycling（RECYC）
information_points.content:
ENV-RECYC-QBW：Chateauroux Aerocenter Hangar Alpha records a closed-loop water recycling efficiency of 75% for its aircraft wash rack reclamation system.
ENV-RECYC-V56：Shannon Atlantic MRO Complex demonstrates a closed-loop water recycling efficiency of 65% across its aircraft exterior wash rack treatment system.
ENV-RECYC-MCM：Prestwick Skybridge Maintenance Center achieves a closed-loop water recycling efficiency of 85% for reclaimed exterior wash water.

information_points.title: Maintains hazardous chemical discharge licenses, acoustic monitoring data, and pollution control filings（ECOL）
information_points.content:
ENV-ECOL-Y08：At Prestwick Skybridge Maintenance Center, there is no certified hazardous materials discharge permit for the chemical stripping and solvent effluent drainage, although an approved environmental noise mitigation plan is officially validated for ground testing operations and acoustic enclosures.
ENV-ECOL-XLN：For the Shannon Atlantic MRO Complex, records confirm an active certified hazardous materials discharge permit covering the chemical paint stripping and solvent washing effluent system, alongside an approved environmental noise mitigation plan validating the facility's high-power ground run-up acoustic enclosure and curfew operations.
ENV-ECOL-BWC：Chateauroux Aerocenter Hangar Alpha maintains a certified hazardous materials discharge permit authorized for its chemical paint stripping and solvent washing effluent system, as well as an approved environmental noise mitigation plan formalizing curfew controls and acoustic enclosures for engine run-up pens.
